command:
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('native_messages.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='b1a2d3b8b32258812930f0b40a443391e781eda259e549e1b92e270bd291678e', 'The supplied local API was modified'
import native_messages
from chat import store,restore
message={'id':'m1','role':'assistant','parts':[{'type':'text','text':'Answer'},{'type':'tool-result','tool':'lookup','result':{'found':True}},{'type':'data-note','value':7}]}
expected=native_messages.encode(message);native_messages.calls.clear();stored=store(message);restored=restore(stored)
assert restored==message and stored==expected
assert 'encode' in native_messages.calls and 'decode' in native_messages.calls
assert message['parts'][1]['result']=={'found':True}
